verdict: Paid ads are efficient; key funnel buildouts are overdue and being resolved.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns returned $6,444.32 in revenue on $1,409.23 in spend — a 4.57x return — and that efficiency actually improved 10.74% in the most recent 7 days, driven by higher revenue per order rather than more purchases. Purchase volume has been flat-to-soft in the last three days, which is worth watching but consistent with a rising average order value pattern. Several funnel milestones — including UTM tracking, subscribe pages, and automated flows — are overdue and being completed now; once live, they will give a clearer read on lead conversion and subscription activity. Google Business Profile engagement showed a sharp drop week-over-week, and we are confirming whether that reflects a data gap or a real shift in local visibility before drawing conclusions.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend across all Meta activity in the last 28 days
revenue generated from 35 purchases this period
improvement in 7-day return on ad spend versus the prior 7 days

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement fell 48% week-over-week, with zero recorded actions in the last three days of the window — local visibility may be softening.
watch_item.fix: We are auditing the data pipeline first to rule out a reporting gap; if the drop is real, local search activity will be addressed immediately.
